_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 02: 2023-08-25 to 2023-10-09. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: Coming miracles will be large enough to read as a next chapter of the Bible, including believers translated bodily from a city in America to Africa, Asia or Australia to preach.
mentions.quote: translating from one place to another going and preaching the gospel
mentions.falsify_match: Credible multiply-witnessed reports of bodily translation between continents.

mentions.claim_text: Exhortation to praise and brag on God, with the promise that great things follow.
mentions.quote: tell what great things he's going to do he's going to do it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation, no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He prays against a warned cyber attack and false flag events on the electric grid, naming Miami, Los Angeles, Phoenix, Denver and Seattle, and declares it will not happen.
mentions.quote: the electric grid over over a Miami from L.A to to Phoenix to to Denver
mentions.condition_text: he explicitly prays the warned attack down and says it will not happen
mentions.falsify_match: A cyber attack causing grid failure across several named US metros.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack, which he would attribute to this prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says that on 5 July the Lord warned him of a major volcano that would be very destructive and cause a lot of damage, and he now ties that to earthquake activity in Italy.
mentions.quote: back on July 5th I did a video about a a major volcano going off
mentions.falsify_match: A major destructive volcanic eruption in Italy.

mentions.claim_text: The volcano comes up out of the water, water rushes over the area, all air traffic around it is shut down, and he says the Lord showed it would cost hundreds of thousands of deaths.
mentions.quote: it cost hundreds of thousands of deaths when this happened
mentions.falsify_match: A submarine or coastal eruption near Italy killing on the order of a hundred thousand or more and closing regional airspace.
mentions.falsify_miss: No eruption on anything like that scale.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the biggest earthquake in forty years in that area happened this week at magnitude 4.2, with hundreds of small quakes recorded around it, and reads it as confirmation.
mentions.quote: the biggest earthquake in 40 years happened in that area
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim; the seismic report he offers as confirmation of the volcano word.

mentions.claim_text: Praying over the 2024 elections a year earlier he saw Michelle Obama and Gavin Newsom when neither was in the news, and says a major shakeup in the Democratic Party is close.
mentions.quote: I saw uh Michelle Obama and I saw Gavin and nothing was in the news
mentions.time_phrase: near future, closer to the fall
mentions.falsify_match: The Democratic ticket changes unexpectedly, with Michelle Obama or Newsom involved.
mentions.falsify_miss: The party runs its expected candidate without upheaval.

mentions.claim_text: He cites a well-connected commentator and then Ted Cruz in the same week both saying Michelle Obama could be the 2024 candidate.
mentions.quote: Ted Cruz says that he believes that Michelle Obama could be the 2024
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim; outside speculation he offers as corroboration.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls a warning about the prince of Saudi Arabia and oil going over two hundred dollars a barrel through a secret agreement with Russia and China, and says the BRICS accession announced on 24 August takes effect on 1 January.
mentions.quote: going over $200 a barrel of oil
mentions.falsify_match: Brent or WTI trades above $200 a barrel.

mentions.claim_text: He says he feels very strongly about the month of October, pointing to the nationwide phone alert test on 4 October and to Russia announcing an event of its own.
mentions.quote: I've feel very strong about the month of October
mentions.falsify_match: A major disruptive event in the US or from Russia during October 2023.

mentions.claim_text: Intercession with a guest for godly leaders over the economy, for an awakening and fear of the Lord, and for the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development to advise the president well.
mentions.quote: Father we thank you for Godly leaders in this economy
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession, no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: A company will rise out of the refiner's fire to lay hands on the sick, driven by a wish to populate heaven and depopulate hell; he notes people saying Jesus returns in September this month.
mentions.quote: people are like well he's coming back in September this month
mentions.falsify_match: A visible healing movement emerging after a period of testing.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that the Lord warned him about two hundred dollars for a barrel of oil, tied to Saudi Arabia joining up with Russia.
mentions.quote: he warned me about $200 for a barrel of oil
mentions.falsify_match: Oil reaches $200 a barrel.

mentions.claim_text: He describes how he receives things: a depth perception in the spirit where you see and hear only in part, and says he saw the oil material back in May.
mentions.quote: there's a depth perception of things. And so you you see in part
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an account of his own method, and an explicit hedge on precision.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him August the 24th was a very significant day and to pray over it without saying why, and that they are only now seeing the first blades of what was given in May of the previous year.
mentions.quote: August the 24th is a very significant day
mentions.falsify_match: An event of lasting significance dated to 24 August 2023.

mentions.claim_text: He says, marking it as an impression rather than prophecy, that the Lord is giving a season of perhaps a year, eighteen months or two years before the harder things.
mentions.quote: Whether it's a year, a year and a half, or two years
mentions.falsify_match: A recognisable window of relative calm running into 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: Severe trouble arrives well before then.

mentions.claim_text: He describes 2024 as his spiritual year running from Rosh Hashanah 2023 to Rosh Hashanah 2024, says viewers may receive it too, and states he is not believing for an economic fallout right on top of us.
mentions.quote: I'm not believing for an economic fallout uh like right on top of our
mentions.falsify_match: No US economic collapse between the autumn of 2023 and the autumn of 2024.
mentions.falsify_miss: A collapse arrives inside that window.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts a dream in which an angel said great judgment was coming in 569 days and told him to intercede, and he counts the 569 days out to 2 October.
mentions.quote: In 569 days, um there would be a great there will be great judgment
mentions.condition_text: the angel's instruction was to intercede over it
mentions.falsify_match: A judgment-scale event on or about 2 October 2023.

mentions.claim_text: He says the angel would not give more, that it would come in pieces as he prayed, and that when the 569 days came about in August the Lord told him he was extending more time.
mentions.quote: Brandon I'm giving more time. I'm extending more time
mentions.falsify_match: The extension is itself unfalsifiable: a missed date is absorbed as more time granted.

mentions.claim_text: He expects Saudi Arabia to go full swing into BRICS along with the UAE and Egypt, citing an article that some eighty percent of the world's oil wealth joins BRICS by 1 January.
mentions.quote: 80% of all the oil wealth of the world is going to join the BRICS
mentions.falsify_match: Saudi Arabia and the UAE formally accede to BRICS on 1 January 2024, carrying most of world oil wealth.
mentions.falsify_miss: Accession is partial, delayed or declined.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him in January that the beginning of the digital dollar would be seen in 2023, not its full manifestation but bits and pieces heard about.
mentions.quote: You will start to see the beginning of the digital dollar in uh 2023
mentions.falsify_match: Visible official movement toward a US digital dollar during 2023.

mentions.claim_text: He says the indictments will run clear into the summer and be very serious, that he was shown praying over Trump's life, and that he was taken into the fall of 2024 to pray over the elections.
mentions.quote: the indictments will go clear into the the the summer
mentions.time_phrase: into the summer, then fall of 2024
mentions.falsify_match: Trump prosecutions continue into summer 2024 alongside a threat to his life.
mentions.falsify_miss: The cases resolve early and no threat materialises.

mentions.claim_text: Everything held back is released in 2025, seen as a sludge of filth, and he calls 2025 a very serious year and 2026 serious too, telling viewers to be prepared.
mentions.quote: everything that was being held back was going to be released in 2025
mentions.falsify_match: A mass release of suppressed material in 2025 followed by a severe 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such release and no severe turn.

mentions.claim_text: He gives it as his own opinion that a two-state solution will be agreed between September and sometime in 2024 and that the third temple will start to be rebuilt.
mentions.quote: we will see uh a two-state solution become agreed upon between September
mentions.falsify_match: A two-state agreement reached and third temple construction begun by end of 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He expects a big turnaround of things, says no man knows the day or the hour, and adds that if Christ returned in September it would be between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur at the feast of trumpets.
mentions.quote: I believe he will come around Roashana to Yong Kapor
mentions.time_phrase: September, Rosh Hashanah to Yom Kippur
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an explicitly hedged if-then about a date no man knows.

mentions.claim_text: He reasons that the seven year tribulation must start on a shmita cycle, that this year is the first of the current one, and that it could therefore be about six years away.
mentions.quote: The seven years tribulation starts on a schmita cycle
mentions.falsify_match: The tribulation begins at the close of the shmita cycle around 2029 to 2030.

mentions.claim_text: He connects the spring eclipse crossing America over the New Madrid fault with an Israeli article pushing to complete the two-state solution.
mentions.quote: the eclipses go over America and it goes right over the New Madrid
mentions.falsify_match: Something of consequence on the New Madrid at or near the April 2024 eclipse.
mentions.falsify_miss: The eclipse passes with no New Madrid event.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the article's timetable: the two-state solution and division of the land done by March, within six to twelve months, with third temple construction starting, and calls the April 2024 eclipse a major event.
mentions.quote: have it completely done divide the land and start getting the the Third Temple
mentions.time_phrase: by March, six to twelve months
mentions.falsify_match: Land division agreed and temple construction begun on roughly that timetable.

mentions.claim_text: He adds that March is another major event and that Saudi Arabia and its prince will rule over all the holy sites.
mentions.quote: Saudi Arabia will rule over all the holy sites
mentions.falsify_match: Saudi Arabia gains custodianship or control over the Jerusalem holy sites.
mentions.falsify_miss: Custodianship stays with Jordan and Israel.

mentions.claim_text: He says famine may be all around us but he refuses to participate in the financial crash or the Great Depression, and that his household will have more than enough because he is a tither, giver and sower.
mentions.quote: I refuse to participate in the financial crash
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on tithing, giving and sowing
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a personal exemption whose failure is always attributable to the giver.

mentions.claim_text: Closing exhortation to believe for the impossible because God is no respecter of persons, built on the widow's last meal.
mentions.quote: believe for the impossible believe the impossible
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation, no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He says everything is being sped up and coming fast, and that he deliberately never names a year for Christ's return because he wants people looking for him today.
mentions.quote: I never want to quote a time frame of saying when is Jesus coming
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an explicit refusal to date the claim.

mentions.claim_text: He dates his visitation to 2014 and notes that 6 July 2024 makes ten years, saying that at the time he thought it meant immediately but it turned out to be a decade, and that we are right there now.
mentions.quote: July the 6th of 2024 to be 10 years so right there we're we're
mentions.falsify_match: Something answering the 2014 visitation lands around 6 July 2024.
